verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence shows a first-party business bank account for Gusto's own users, provided through Increase Bank and still in early beta. Nothing shows a developer-facing capability to embed banking accounts for the developer's own customers. That first-party feature is adjacent and earns no credit toward an embedded-banking offering for developers. The developer surfaces in the pack, an MCP server and a CLI, are aimed at payroll workflows, not banking-as-a-service.
